subject: eng
title: Grammar 5B Overview: Past Continuous, Connectives (when/while/although) & Reflexives

questions.q: I ___ a shower when the telephone rang.
questions.explain: 表示電話響起那一刻正在進行的長動作，用過去進行式 was having。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: I ___ a shower when the telephone rang.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 5B Overview: Past Continuous, Connectives (when/while/although) & Reflexives

questions.q: While Mum ___ dinner, Dad was setting the table.
questions.explain: while 連接兩個同時在過去持續進行的動作，都用過去進行式（was cooking）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: While Mum ___ dinner, Dad was setting the table.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 5B Overview: Past Continuous, Connectives (when/while/although) & Reflexives

questions.q: ___ it was raining heavily, the firemen kept working.
questions.explain: 前後兩句意思轉折（「雖然下大雨，但消防員繼續工作」），句首用連接詞 Although。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: ___ it was raining heavily, the firemen kept working.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 5B Overview: Past Continuous, Connectives (when/while/although) & Reflexives

questions.q: Be careful with the paper cutter! Don't hurt ___.
questions.explain: 祈使句主語是隱含的 you，反身代詞（reflexive pronoun）用 yourself（別弄傷你自己）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Be careful with the paper cutter! Don't hurt ___.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 5B Overview: Past Continuous, Connectives (when/while/although) & Reflexives

questions.q: The children enjoyed ___ very much at the Christmas party.
questions.explain: enjoy oneself 表示「玩得開心」，複數主語 The children 對應 themselves。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: The children enjoyed ___ very much at the Christmas party.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 5B Overview: Past Continuous, Connectives (when/while/although) & Reflexives

questions.q: Fill in the reflexive pronoun: Leo made this model plane all by ___ (he).
questions.explain: by himself 表示「靠他自己獨立完成」。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Fill in the reflexive pronoun: Leo made this model plane all by ___ (he).
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 5B Overview: Past Continuous, Connectives (when/while/although) & Reflexives

questions.q: Rearrange the words to form a correct sentence.
questions.explain: 過去進行式長動作 + when + 過去式短動作：I was reading a book when the lights went out.
